about: Imported cases whose expectations predate a spec change Trellis follows. trellis-case skips them by default (counted as upstream-stale); --all runs them. Remove an entry when upstream rebaselines the case.

cases.wpt-grid/css/css-grid/layout-algorithm/g: CSSWG #3648 (distribute space to non-affected tracks, CSS Grid 2 12.5.1): the expectation is pre-#3648. WebKit passes it only through legacy RenderGrid, since width:100% items keep the file out of its GFC; WebKit 322402@main rebaselined the GFC-covered grid-gutters-and-flex-content-001 instead.
